module.purpose: This file centralizes branding-visibility resolution for user and team events, applying entity settings with organization-level overrides and retrieving missing profile data when necessary.
module.summary: The module evaluates whether product branding should be hidden for teams, users, and their events. It prioritizes organization settings over entity settings, treats missing values as visible by default, queries repositories when identifiers or profiles are unavailable, and logs events lacking an owner or team.
module.businessContext:
Supports white-label and organization branding preferences across scheduling events.
Incorrect resolution can expose platform branding where customers expect their own identity, or hide branding unexpectedly.
classes: Team (~L10-15): Represents team branding settings and inherited parent organization branding configuration.
Profile (~L17-21): Represents organization branding settings associated with a user profile.
UserWithoutProfile (~L23-26): Represents user identity and branding settings without loaded profile data.
UserWithProfile (~L28-30): Represents user data augmented with an optional profile and organization.
functions: resolveHideBranding (~L35-45): Resolves effective branding visibility from entity and organization settings.
getHideBranding (~L50-80): Retrieves branding visibility for a user or team identifier.
shouldHideBrandingForEventUsingProfile (~L85-110): Determines event branding visibility using supplied owner or team profiles.
shouldHideBrandingForEvent (~L116-153): Resolves event branding visibility while fetching missing user profile information.
shouldHideBrandingForTeamEvent (~L158-164): Provides a team-specific convenience wrapper for event branding resolution.
shouldHideBrandingForUserEvent (~L169-181): Provides a user-specific convenience wrapper for event branding resolution.

io: Reads user branding settings through userRepository.findUserWithHideBranding.
Reads a user profile through ProfileRepository.findByUserIdAndOrgSlug.
Logs an error when no owner or team is available for an event.

detail.name: getHideBranding
preconditions: The argument is an object whose optional userId and teamId values are numbers when provided.
The referenced repositories and resolveHideBranding dependency are available.
postconditions: If a truthy teamId is provided, the result is based on the team and its parent organization's hide-branding values.

Repository lookup failures are not converted into a boolean result by this function.

When userId is truthy, teamId is falsy, and the user lookup returns no user, resolves to false.
When both identifiers are absent or falsy, performs no repository lookup and resolves to false.
When both identifiers are truthy, only the team lookup path is used.

detail.name: shouldHideBrandingForEventUsingProfile
detail.signature: export function shouldHideBrandingForEventUsingProfile({ eventTypeId, owner, team }: { owner: UserWithProfile | null; team: Team | null; eventTypeId: number })

parameters.name: { eventTypeId, owner, team }
parameters.type: { owner: UserWithProfile | null; team: Team | null; eventTypeId: number }

preconditions: The argument is an object containing numeric eventTypeId and nullable owner and team properties.
postconditions: If team is truthy, the result is the value returned by resolveHideBranding using team-level and parent-level hideBranding values.
If no team is present and owner is truthy, the result is the value returned by resolveHideBranding using owner-level and profile-organization-level hideBranding values.
If neither team nor owner is present, false is returned and an error is logged.
invariants: A provided team takes precedence over a provided owner.
Nullish hideBranding values are converted to null before being passed to resolveHideBranding.
The function does not mutate owner, team, or eventTypeId.
edgeCases: When both team and owner are provided, only team and team.parent hideBranding values are used.
When team is absent and owner is provided, owner.hideBranding and owner.profile?.organization?.hideBranding are used.
When both team and owner are null or otherwise falsy, the function logs the event-specific error and returns false.
When a selected hideBranding value is undefined, it is passed to resolveHideBranding as null.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: If neither team nor owner is available, log an error and return false.

units.name: shouldHideBrandingForEvent

detail.name: shouldHideBrandingForEvent
preconditions: The input object contains an eventTypeId, team, owner, and organizationId matching their declared types.
postconditions: Resolves to the boolean result returned by the applicable team-event or user-event helper.
If neither a team nor an owner is provided, resolves to false.
invariants: When both team and owner are provided, the team-event path is selected and the owner path is not evaluated.
The owner profile lookup is performed only on the owner path and when organizationId is truthy.
The owner-event helper receives the owner data augmented with the retrieved profile or null.
edgeCases: When team is non-null, delegates to shouldHideBrandingForTeamEvent with team and eventTypeId without consulting the owner or profile repository.
When team is null, owner is non-null, and organizationId is truthy, asynchronously retrieves the profile by user ID and organization ID before delegating to shouldHideBrandingForUserEvent.
When team is null, owner is non-null, and organizationId is null or otherwise falsy, skips profile lookup and delegates with a null profile.
When both team and owner are null, logs an error containing the event type ID and resolves to false.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No owner or team results in an error log and a false result; no other invalid-input behavior is defined.
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: false when neither team nor owner is present

detail.summary: Determines whether branding should be hidden for an event based on its team or user owner. Team ownership takes precedence; user ownership may require loading the owner's organization profile.

specTests.then: It delegates to the team-event helper with the team and eventTypeId, and resolves to that helper's boolean result without performing a profile lookup.
It looks up the owner's profile using owner.id and organizationId, augments the owner with that profile, and resolves to the user-event helper's boolean result.
It logs an error for the eventTypeId and resolves to false.
